name: inputCard
intent: Check the supplied bank card and establish the card session when the card has an owner.
pre: A bank card with the supplied cardid exists.
bc.oclIsUndefined() = false
The selected card has status NORMAL.
bc.CardStatus=CardStatus::NORMAL
post: If the card has an owner, mark the card ID as validated.
If the card has an owner, make it the current session card.
If the card has an owner, return true.
If the card has no owner, mark the card ID as not validated.
If the card has no owner, return false.
difficulty_basis: Owner-dependent branch controls the result and persistent session bindings.
scenarios: Owned-card scenario checks validation, session card and true result.
Ownerless-card scenario exercises the permitted false-result branch, not a failed precondition.
Missing-card rejection is explained by the existence guard; unchanged session is an oracle rejection convention.
effects_audit: Both return branches and session effects retained. No owner-existence precondition or session-clearing effect invented.

name: inputPassword
intent: Validate the supplied password for the current bank-card session.
pre: The current card ID has been validated.
self.CardIDValidated = true
A current session card is present.
self.InputCard.oclIsUndefined() = false
post: If the supplied password matches the card password, mark the password as validated.
If the supplied password matches the card password, return true.
If the supplied password does not match, mark the password as not validated.
If the supplied password does not match, return false.
scenarios: Matching password sets the flag and returns true.
Mismatch is a specified false-result branch.
Missing current card violates the guard.
effects_audit: No retry counter, lockout policy or password update is added.

name: checkBalance
intent: Report the balance of the current session card.
pre: The session password has been validated.
self.PasswordValidated = true
The session card ID has been validated.
self.CardIDValidated = true
A current session card is present.
self.InputCard.oclIsUndefined() = false
post: Return the balance of the current session card.
difficulty_basis: Authenticated scalar lookup with no specified update.
conflicts: Positive Jest additionally asserts unchanged balance, card binding and validation flags; the reference has no explicit frame conditions. No mutation or frame guarantee was invented.
scenarios: Returned balance matches; unchanged-state assertions exceed explicit reference clauses.
effects_audit: Only result obligation recovered. No state changes introduced; stronger frame assertions require review.

name: ejectCard
intent: End the authenticated card session and clear its transaction indicators.
pre: The session password has been validated.
self.PasswordValidated = true
The session card ID has been validated.
self.CardIDValidated = true
A current session card is present.
self.InputCard.oclIsUndefined() = false
post: Mark the session password as not validated.
Mark the session card ID as not validated.
Reset the recorded withdrawal amount to zero.
Reset the recorded deposit amount to zero.
difficulty_basis: Unconditional reset of several session fields; no object deletion or branches.
conflicts: Jest checks that the card remains stored without an explicit reference frame clause. The null/undefined representation question has been resolved from the actual lowering code and is no longer a blocker.

review_findings.assessment: The executable dialect lowers the OCL null literal to the TypeScript undefined identifier. Thus clearing InputCard and the Jest toBeUndefined assertion agree in this backend; this is not a claim about every OCL engine. The unrelated repository-frame assertion still needs review.

scenarios: All reset obligations checked. The source lowerer resolves null/undefined equivalence; the additional repository-frame assertion remains under review.
Unauthenticated session violates the validation guards.
effects_audit: All seven resets and result restored. No bank-card deletion inferred from session clearing.
